analysis: Revenue was $2.3M in H1 2026, down 39% year over year.

Operating costs exceeded revenue by $8.3M, an operating margin of -368.3%. Total costs fell 8% while revenue changed -39%. The fastest-growing cost line was SG&A (+11%). The period ended with a net loss of $22.2M. Net interest and other expense of $13.9M was the main reason.

Operating cash flow was −$9.5M. Non-cash charges added back $1.8M of depreciation and amortization and $276K of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items added $10.6M. Capital expenditures of $5.0M exceeded it, leaving free cash flow of −$14.5M.
